say.text: WePic is an Android app that shows the weather together with a photo of the place.
say.speak: We-Pic is an Android app that shows the weather, together with a photo of the place.

say: Not an icon of a cloud, but the real view.
The background is a photo from Unsplash, matched to the location,
and to the current weather when a matching photo exists. If not, it simply shows the city.
There are three ways to look at the world.
or a random city somewhere on the planet.
Every view shows live weather from OpenWeather,
a twenty-four hour forecast you can swipe through,
and the local time at that place.
Turn the phone or tablet sideways, and the weather moves to a slim strip,
so the photo fills the screen, like a window onto another city.
It is written in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Retrofit.
A small Cloudflare Worker keeps the API keys off the phone and caches answers, so many users looking at one city cost a single request.
A cross-platform Flutter port is written, and the Android app is being prepared for Google Play.

say.text: WePic. See the weather the way it looks.
say.speak: We-Pic. See the weather, the way it looks.
